theme.description: Colours, corners, text and motion, light and dark.

app.description: AshlarApp, the app shell on WidgetsApp, in place of MaterialApp.

pressable.description: Hover, press, keyboard focus and activation, for every control.

button.description: Six variants and four sizes, with leading and trailing icons.

badge.description: A small label: a status, a count, a tag.

card.description: A panel with a header, content and a footer.

separator.description: A one-pixel line, across or down.

input.description: A text field with selection handles and a cut, copy and paste menu.

checkbox.description: A box that is ticked or not.

dialog.description: A modal panel over a dimmed page, with title, content and actions.

label.description: The name of a control, above it or beside it.

field.description: A control with its label, description and error, read out together.

textarea.description: A text field for several lines that grows with its text.

avatar.description: A picture in a circle, with initials while it loads or when it fails.

skeleton.description: A pulsing placeholder in the shape of content still loading.

spinner.description: A turning ring that says something is working.

alert.description: A notice, warning or error in the page, read out when it appears.

kbd.description: A keyboard key, for showing shortcuts.

radio.description: A choice of one, in Flutter's RadioGroup, with labels.

tabs.description: Views of one thing, one at a time, chosen from a row of tabs.

popover.description: A panel that opens from a trigger and floats over the page.

dropdown-menu.description: A list of actions that opens from a trigger.

select.description: Picks one value from a list that opens under it.

tooltip.description: A short label over a control on hover, focus or long press.

toast.description: A short message at the bottom of the screen that goes by itself.

group.description: Joins controls into one piece: Button Group and Toggle Group use it.

button-group.description: Buttons joined into one piece, for actions that belong together.

typography.description: Headings, paragraphs, quotes and lists in the theme's type.

empty.description: What to show when there is nothing here yet.

item.description: A row in a list: media, a title and description, and actions.

progress.description: How far along something is, as a bar.

breadcrumb.description: Where a page sits, as links to the pages above it.
